title: Comprehensive Long COVID Center
summary: The aim of the project is to establish a comprehensive care center around Long COVID. In addition to medical care, this will provide patients and their relatives with a wide range of information and support services. Another focus will be on training medical specialist groups in order to provide comprehensive information on this disease.

interventions.name:
- Patients with Long COVID
- PROMs and PREMs for evaluating the CLOCC healthcare model in the course of the project from year 2

- Relatives
- Questionnaire evaluation of information services and care for those affected in the course of the project from year 2

- Medical and therapeutic professionals
- Feedback zu Fortbildungsmaßnahmen, Informationsangeboten in the course of the project from year 2

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Presence of Long COVID
- Ability to understand and follow the nature of the study and the procedures associated with the study
- Suspected COVID-19 disease at least 3 months prior to study inclusion
- Signed written informed consent form
Exclusion criteria:
- Insufficient German language skills to complete the questionnaires; assessed by the study staff
- Current SARS-CoV-2 infection or positive test for SARS-CoV-2
